queries.dr2_neighbourhood: SELECT dr2_source_id, dr3_source_id, angular_distance, magnitude_difference, proper_motion_propagation FROM gaiadr3.dr2_neighbourhood WHERE dr2_source_id IN ({ids}) ORDER BY dr2_source_id, angular_distance
queries.dr3_gaia_source: SELECT source_id, ref_epoch, ra, dec, pmra, pmdec, parallax, phot_g_mean_mag, ruwe, astrometric_params_solved, duplicated_source FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE source_id IN ({ids}) ORDER BY source_id
queries.dr3_reverse_neighbourhood: SELECT dr2_source_id, dr3_source_id, angular_distance, magnitude_difference, proper_motion_propagation FROM gaiadr3.dr2_neighbourhood WHERE dr3_source_id IN ({ids}) ORDER BY dr3_source_id, angular_distance
queries.tic: SELECT id, version, gaia, ra, dec, pmra, pmdec, plx, tmag, gaiamag, gaiaqflag, typesrc, objtype, posflag, pmflag, disposition, duplicate_id, ra_orig, dec_orig FROM dbo.catalogrecord WHERE id IN ({ids})
